conventions.convention: Assume Countable Choice for the Fourier, polar-measure and operator-trace constructions.
Modes are (Z³ minus {0}) × {1,2}, enumerated by max-norm shells and lexicographic order; occupations have finite support. Zero wavevector and zero-point energy are excluded.
Entropy uses the natural logarithm. Continuum limits hold at fixed positive temperature as L tends to infinity.
The singular radial entropy function is assigned g(0)=0 solely for its Lebesgue integral; lattice sums omit the origin.
Flux belongs to a separately stipulated isotropic ray model with angular densities u/(4π), s/(4π), velocity c times the unit direction, and outward-hemisphere integration.
Mass accounting fixes the asymptotic time/energy normalization, 0<η≤1, and 0<M_min<M_0; the model terminates at positive mass. The entropy offset is constant.

load_bearing.statement: Under Countable Choice and the specified positive-parameter, zero-mode-excluded two-polarization diagonal model, the Gibbs multiplier is trace class, every nonnegative integer energy moment is finite, u=π²k_B⁴T⁴/(15ℏ³c³), and s=4u/(3T). In the separately specified isotropic ray model, F=cu/4=σT⁴ and F_S=cs/4=(4/3)F/T.

Assuming Countable Choice, the nonzero-lattice Riemann sums for f(r)=r/(e^r−1) and g(r)=f(r)−log(1−e^(−r)) converge to their finite three-dimensional radial integrals as d decreases to zero; the corresponding radial limit also holds for every continuous compactly supported real test function.

For positive L, β, ℏ, c, the max-norm shell j≥1 has 24j²+2 points; sup q_n=e^(−βa)<1 and Σ ε_n^p q_n<∞ for every integer p≥0. The positive mode-energy sum is finite, and doubling polarization preserves these conclusions.
Assume the Axiom of Countable Choice. The improper integrals ∫₀∞ x³/(e^x−1) dx and ∫₀∞ x²[−log(1−e^(−x))] dx converge to π⁴/15 and π⁴/45, respectively.

Assuming the stated Planck flux formulas and fixed-reference effective-area mass-balance model, M(t)=(M_0³−3αt)^(1/3), α=ηℏc⁴/(15360πG²), and τ=(M_0³−M_min³)/(3α). Through positive cutoff, exported entropy is 4/3 of the B-entropy decrease and total entropy change is 1/3 of that decrease.

concerns.concern: The Statement writes U_L=Tr(ρ_L H), and step 3.1 calls the diagonal sum this trace. With H defined on D(H), the literal composition ρ_L H has domain D(H), whereas the cited trace convention requires an everywhere-defined bounded trace-class operator. Specify its unique bounded diagonal extension (equivalently Hρ_L), whose entries are p_m E(m), and justify trace class from their proved summability. The finite energy sum is already established; this is a short domain/notation completion.
